description: Base token transfers: Recent ERC-20 Transfer events for a token contract on Base, newest first, decoded with the token's decimals: up to 200 events within the last 20,000 blocks (you choose the window). Source: Base public RPCs. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: token{symbol, decimals}, window{scanned_blocks, from_block, to_block}, items[{block, tx, from, to, amount}], truncated.

blocks.description: how many recent blocks to search, 1-20000 (default 1000)
